_about: Pre-registered criteria for the spatial register's eval (spec 2026-09-27-materialist-spatial-register.md, D), written 2026-09-27 before any build, from the brief's expected_output in evals/materialist.json (id 7). A grader answers holds / partial / fails per criterion per arm with one line of evidence. Brief 8 is the matched instrument-register control (spec D, added after the spec's adversarial review): materialist arm only; c1 is the register choice and is scored apart from execution on both briefs.
7: c1 The record names the register chosen (glass as the surface, set into the live view) and the reason, rather than a floating bar over a photograph or translucent cards

c2 The view is one full-bleed, viewport-fixed texture plane; the level under every content surface is measured from the painted pixels and recorded, outside 0.39 to 0.49 in both schemes, or the plane is graded / the surfaces placed to keep it so
c3 At most three content surfaces at rest, each a unit of the guest's task, sized to its content, with the view visible around it
c4 Every text-bearing surface is at or above span 96; one thickness; generous fixed radii; the surface's corner named as the concentric anchor
c5 Ink is the runtime's vibrancy tokens on child elements (primary for standard text and controls, secondary for descriptions), weights medium through bold, no tertiary or quaternary on anything read
c6 Body text contrast measured on rendered pixels at 4.5 in both schemes, every reading recorded, any miss stated as a failure

c7 Inside a surface every row, input, selection and inner control is a fill with a role (darker to separate or hold an input, lighter for interactive or selected, never lighter on lighter), never a second glass host

c8 Any control with its own material is an ornament: a separate overlay-plane surface outside the content surface's edge at the runtime's derived gap, holding plain buttons; at most one tinted; content surfaces untinted
c9 The menu scrolls inside its surface with scroll edges on the inner scroller; the plane never scrolls; sheets emerge from their control by morph and a modal task darkens the plane beneath
c10 Regular variant throughout; clear not spent (or spent only over media the guest watches, with a painted dimming layer, recorded)
c11 The record names the CSS tier's collapsed body as that tier's design and states that the material's laws are extrapolated beyond the bed's largest span
c12 Reduce Transparency offered as a setting and passed as a boolean; forced colours looked at with every authored fill surviving substitution
c13 Zero dev-mode diagnostics on the built page
8: c1 The record names the instrument register with a product-based reason (the content is the world, acted on with a few controls) and puts no glass window or module under the rooms, the trails or the story
c2 The photograph is one viewport-fixed texture plane; the navigation and Book control float over it as capsule housings in a family straddling 32 to 96
c3 Content reaches the edges and passes under the bar behind a scroll edge on the scrolling content; insets derived from the bar's measured size
c4 The Book control is the one tinted surface or none, recorded
c5 Hints declared only where the runtime's own reading is not the displayed composite, measured from the painted pixels
c6 Contrast measured on rendered pixels in both schemes, readings recorded
c7 Reduce Transparency offered as a setting and passed as a boolean; forced colours looked at
c8 Zero dev-mode diagnostics on the built page
